items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 22:1
items.html: We will inform that the seven lower [Sefirot] of Nekudim were broken front and back, and they mingled and became included one in the other, until there is no small spark that is not included from all the 320 sparks — that is, from all the aspects of the vessels of ABYA. Therefore it is discerned in them that the face [Panim] is included in the posterior [Achoraim], and likewise the posterior is included also from the face. And from the face itself were sorted the vessels of the smallness of ZA, which are the HBD HGT of the vessels and the HGT NHY of the lights. And from the posterior included in the vessels of the face were sorted all the vessels of the Achoraim of ZON, which come in them at the time of the greatness. And from the vessels of the face included in the Achoraim were sorted all the Partzufim of BYA. And from the aspect of the Achoraim included in the Partzufim of BYA — that is, from the aspect of the point of the Chazeh in them — was sorted the soul of Adam HaRishon. (Part 1, Page 955, subheading "and against").
